answer_1.quote: We introduce EverGreenQA -the first multilingual human-curated evergreen-aware QA dataset, which includes a train-test split suitable for model training.
answer_1.outputs: question answering outputs, evergreen classification predictions, golden answers

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using standard metrics widely adopted in recent literature on uncertainty estimation . AUROC measures how well the model distinguishes between correct and incorrect answers based on the self-knowledge score f (x). Higher values indicate stronger separability. AUPRC quantifies the trade-off between precision and recall across different decision thresholds.

answer_3.quote: We randomly selected 200 evergreen and 200 mutable questions from the test set and asked GPT-4.1 to classify them as Simple (all relevant information explicit) or Complex (requiring additional inference).

answer_4.quote: We recruited human evaluators for each target language, all of whom are either native speakers or possess advanced proficiency (B2-C1 level). We randomly sampled 100 questions from the test set (50 mutable, 50 evergreen) for each language; additionally, for Hebrew we manually verified 200 further items (300 in total).
answer_4.guideline: Validation assessor instruction is provided in Appendix D.
